transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, um, what brought me in is... I guess I keep leaving my station at work. Like, I'll just pop up during meetings or when I'm on the line, and I'm supposed to stay put. My supervisor says it's becoming a safety problem because I just take off before I even think about it. Which is crazy because the other day, I was walking past the breakroom and they had these donuts—like, the really good ones with the maple frosting? And I haven't had one of those since my sister's baby shower, which was a whole disaster because her husband forgot to pick up the ice, so we had warm soda all afternoon. But yeah, my boss is really getting on my case about me not staying in my seat.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized or high, like you needed much less sleep than usual?

Unusually energized? No, not really. I mean, I always have a lot of energy, but I still need to sleep. I actually love sleeping, my bed is super comfy. I just got this new memory foam thing from Walmart because my old mattress was getting all lumpy, and my cat kept scratching at the corner of it. His name is Macaroni, he's this huge orange tabby. He actually brought a giant moth into my room last night and was just batting it around the floor for like an hour. It was so annoying! I mean, it was kind of funny, but he was making so much noise jumping against the closet door. I had to get up and put him in the hallway so I could actually get some rest. But wait, what did you ask me? Something about being high or not sleeping? Yeah, no, I don't get like that. I just sleep regular.
Do your emotions tend to shift very quickly and intensely?

Shift quickly? Um, no, I don't think so. I mean, I get mad if someone messes with me or whatever, but I'm pretty normal with how I feel. Not like my coworker, Jessica. Oh my gosh, she was just bawling on the line on Tuesday. Like, sobbing so hard she dropped a whole tray of components. Turns out her boyfriend dumped her over a Snapchat message, which is super messed up, right? Who does that? But it made me think about my phone, because I actually dropped mine right after that happened on the concrete floor and the screen protector totally shattered. Thank God it was just the protector, though, because I literally just paid off this phone and I can't afford a new one right now. The concrete floors at the plant are so hard, honestly, my feet are just killing me by the end of my shift. I keep meaning to buy those gel inserts for my boots, but I always forget when I go to the store. I always get distracted by the makeup aisle. Wait... what were we talking about? Oh, my emotions? Yeah, no, I'm pretty chill. They don't jump around or anything.
Did you have trouble staying seated in class when you were a child?

Yeah, oh my gosh, all the time. Even in elementary school, I was always the kid who couldn't stay in my seat. I'd be up wandering around the room, looking at the posters or whatever. And I was always talking over the teacher, just blurting things out before she even finished her sentence. My mom got so many notes sent home about it. She used to keep them in this big yellow folder in the kitchen drawer. That drawer was so full of junk, honestly. It had all these old takeout menus, and half of the places aren't even open anymore. Like that Chinese place down the street? They closed last year and turned into a vape shop. Which is crazy because there's literally another vape shop right across the street from it. How many do we really need? I tried one of those disposable ones once, the blue razz flavor, and it made me cough so bad. I felt like my lungs were on fire. My friend Sarah smokes them all the time, though. She goes through like two a week. She works at the mall, at that pretzel place. Have you had those? The cinnamon sugar ones are the best, especially when they're fresh out of the oven. But yeah, what did you ask me? Oh, school! Yeah, I couldn't sit still at all. Always getting in trouble for it.
